stories.title: North Wales Police online reporting and webchat to be disrupted on Friday morning
stories.summary: North Wales Police’s online reporting and webchat services are likely to be affected for several hours on Friday morning because of planned maintenance work. stories.title: Flintshire council officer says debate over councillor pay has become “toxic”
stories.summary: A senior Flintshire Council officer has said the debate over councillors’ pay has become “toxic”. Gareth Owens, the council’s chief officer for governance, told a committee on Thursday, 5 November: “It’s a real shame that the debate about this is so toxic because, of course, public services are a really important aspect of our community.”

stories.title: Flintshire council committee votes to reverse new call-in limits
stories.summary: A Flintshire committee has voted to recommend scrapping new limits on councillors’ power to challenge decisions, ten days after full council approved them. The Constitution and Democratic Services Committee backed the move on Thursday, 5 November, on the casting vote of its chair, Cllr David Coggins Cogan, after members split evenly. stories.title: Shops in Wales face fines of up to £2,500 for selling energy drinks to under-16s
stories.summary: Shops across Wales could be fined up to £2,500 for selling high-caffeine energy drinks to under-16s, under plans published by the Welsh Government.
